sections.label: Energy efficiency schemes for businesses
sections.summary: Most applicants are micro-SMEs under $1 million revenue, over half from food services, and businesses can use other energy efficiency schemes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The majority of applicants are from micro-SMEs with annual revenue of less than $1 million and more than half are from the food services sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In addition to the EEG, businesses can also tap on other energy efficiency schemes, like what I mentioned during the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) Committee of Supply (COS) debate yesterday, including the National Environment Agency’s (NEA) Energy Efficiency Fund, the Economic Development Board’s (EDB) Resource Efficiency Grant for Emissions and the Building and Construction Authority’s (BCA) Green Mark Incentive Scheme for Existing Buildings 2.0.

sections.label: EEG for three SME sectors
sections.summary: The EEG, launched 1 September, focuses on food services, food manufacturing and retail SMEs affected by higher electricity prices, with MTI working with trade associations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For example, the food services, the food manufacturing as well as the retail sectors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This is why we have curated the EEG and when we launched it on 1 September, we are focusing on the SMEs in these three sectors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Because based on our feedback and based on our dialogue with the companies as well as with the trade association and chambers (TACs) representing the sector, these are the sectors which have been significantly affected by higher electricity prices in terms of the impact on their overall business cost.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, the EEG supports the firms in these three sectors in improving the energy efficiency and alleviating increasing business costs, due to increased energy prices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The scheme was only launched five months ago and since then, we have been working with the TACs, specifically Restaurant Association of Singapore, Singapore Retailers Association and Singapore Business Federation, and other TACs like Singapore Chinese Chamber of Commerce and so on, to raise awareness of this scheme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And now we are focused on following up on the interest that has been surfaced by the companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to assure the Member that MTI will certainly continue to work closely with our industry partners including TACs and the companies in these three sectors to explore and develop cost competitive and secure solutions that will meet both our long-term energy needs and low emission targets.
